name: Time Doctor
description: Time Doctor is an employee time tracking and workforce productivity platform that provides real-time work insights, activity monitoring, screenshots, and automated payroll for remote and hybrid teams.

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: Includes time tracking, task tracking, activity monitoring, and 1 screenshot per 30 minutes (billed annually at $5.90/mo or monthly at $7/mo).

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Adds app & URL tracking, automated payroll integrations, 60+ integrations, and up to 3 screenshots per 9 minutes (billed annually at $8.40/mo or monthly at $10/mo).

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Adds client login access, VIP support, video screen recording, and internet connectivity reporting (billed annually at $16.70/mo or monthly at $20/mo).

best_for: Positioned for BPO companies, remote agencies, outsourcing firms, and enterprises needing granular employee activity metrics, proof of work, distraction management, and automated payroll.
pros: Granular productivity monitoring with optional screencasts and activity level scores
Automated distraction detection with popups when visiting unproductive sites
Direct payroll integrations with PayPal, Wise, and Payoneer for global payouts
Client portal access allowing agencies to share verified time and proof of work
cons: No perpetual free plan available (14-day free trial only)
Strict monitoring capabilities may raise privacy concerns among employees
Video screen recording and VIP support restricted to the highest Premium tier
features: Real-time employee time tracking across desktop, web, and mobile devices
Automated screen capture and video recording with customizable blur settings
Keystroke and mouse activity level tracking to measure engagement
App and website usage categorization with unproductive site alerts
Automated timesheets with attendance and work schedule reporting
Direct global payroll integration with Wise, PayPal, Payoneer, and Gusto
Client login portal for agencies to share real-time billable project progress
60+ software integrations including Jira, Asana, Trello, and Slack

alternatives.name: Hubstaff
alternatives.description: A workforce management and time tracking tool with automated timesheets, activity monitoring, and payroll integrations.
alternatives.best_for: Remote and field teams needing proof-of-work tracking, geofencing, and automated payroll

alternatives.name: Toggl Track
alternatives.description: A time tracking tool with one-click timers, background activity tracking, and profitability reporting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams preferring non-invasive timer tracking without screenshot capture

alternatives.name: Clockify
alternatives.description: A time tracking and timesheet app with attendance, scheduling, and a free plan for unlimited users.
alternatives.best_for: Budget-conscious teams needing free basic timesheets and time tracking
